name: CodeFaeries Ask AI About Us
author: Long Watch Studio - Code Faeries

sections.description:
CodeFaeries Ask AI About Us shows your visitors you have nothing to hide: a row of “Ask ChatGPT about us”, “Ask Grok about us” and “Ask Claude about us” buttons after the footer of every page. A click opens the assistant in a new tab, in the visitor’s own account, with a question about your whole site already written: its name, its address, whether it is a reliable company and what its customers say.

No API key, no running cost: the plugin only prints links. Nothing about the visitor goes through your server.

Features:

  • Buttons for ChatGPT, Grok and Claude, shown as soon as the plugin is activated
  • Gemini available as an option: it opens an empty conversation, since it does not accept a prefilled question
  • Choose the assistants shown under Settings > Ask AI
  • The question and the button labels follow your site’s language, and the plugin is translation-ready
  • Accessible buttons: reachable with the keyboard, announced with their destination and the new tab they open
  • Works with any theme and wraps on narrow screens
  • Same output on every page, so it works with page caching
  • Loads nothing from a third-party server: no font, icon or script
  • Uninstalling the plugin deletes its settings

External services

This plugin links to third-party AI assistants. It does not contact them from your server and sends them nothing on its own: each button is a plain link.

When, and only when, a visitor clicks a button, their own browser opens that assistant’s website in a new tab. For the assistants that accept a prefilled question, the link carries that question, which contains your site’s name and home page address. The assistant then receives what any visit to its website sends, under its own terms and privacy policy, and the visitor uses it with their own account if they have one.

  • ChatGPT (chatgpt.com), shown by default, receives the question in the link. Terms of use: https://openai.com/policies/row-terms-of-use/ Privacy policy: https://openai.com/policies/row-privacy-policy/
  • Grok (grok.com), shown by default, receives the question in the link. Terms of service: https://x.ai/legal/terms-of-service Privacy policy: https://x.ai/legal/privacy-policy
  • Claude (claude.ai), shown by default, receives the question in the link. Terms of service: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/consumer-terms Privacy policy: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy
  • Gemini (gemini.google.com), hidden by default, opens an empty conversation: no question is sent. Terms of service: https://policies.google.com/terms Privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy and https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/13594961

Privacy

The plugin sets no cookie, stores nothing about visitors and makes no request of its own. It stores a single setting, the list of assistants shown.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/codefaeries-ask-ai directory, or install the plugin from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins screen. The buttons appear after the footer right away.
  3. Optionally, choose the assistants shown under Settings > Ask AI.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin use an AI API or need a key?

No. Each button is a link to the assistant’s own website: the visitor asks the question there, with their own account.

What question is sent?

For a site named Example Shop at https://example.com/: “What do you know about Example Shop (https://example.com/)? Is it a reliable company, and what do its customers say?”, translated into your site’s language when a translation is available. The question is about your whole site, whatever page the visitor is on.

Why does Gemini open an empty conversation?

Gemini does not accept a question in the link, so its button opens a new conversation where the visitor types the question. That is why it is hidden by default.

Can I place the buttons somewhere else?

Not in this plugin: the row is printed after the theme footer. Developers can turn that automatic output off with the codefaeries_ask_ai_footer_enabled filter.
sections.changelog:
0.1.1

  • Fixed: a second copy of the plugin loaded on the same site, such as one bundled inside another plugin, no longer causes a fatal error. The first copy loaded runs, the other stays inactive.
  • New: developers can put an icon before, after or instead of each button label with the codefaeries_ask_ai_button_content filter. Only span, img and svg markup is kept, and an image given as a data: URI is removed: use an image URL or an inline svg.

0.1.0

First release. Adds a row of “Ask (assistant) about us” buttons after the footer of every page.

  • ChatGPT, Grok and Claude buttons shown by default, Gemini as an option.
  • Choice of the assistants shown under Settings > Ask AI.
  • Question and labels in the site’s language.
  • Accessible, responsive buttons that work with any theme and with page caching.
  • Settings deleted on uninstall.

short_description: Adds a row of buttons after your footer that let visitors ask an AI assistant what it knows about your site.
